description: Deliver worker prompts out-of-band (O(1) tmux argv) and make every tmux dispatch verified + observably terminal, ending the CAM-433 silent planner/auditor wedge

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Bun.spawnSync returns stdout AND stderr as Buffer on SyncSubprocess when piped; note Bun.spawn's DEFAULT stderr is 'inherit' (stdout 'pipe'), so stderr must be explicitly piped and decoded. Confirms the loopSpawnFn fix is a decode-what-is-already-there change (result.stderr Buffer -> TextDecoder), no API deprecations.

Man page confirms respawn-pane -k (kills existing command, reactivates pane) and pipe-pane semantics; the web fetch truncated before FORMATS, so FORMATS were verified against the LOCAL man page and live tmux 3.6a: pane_pid ('PID of first process in pane') EXISTS; pane_start_time does NOT exist in 3.6a (display-message expands it to empty string, verified live 2026-07-27), so the AC5 identity signal must be pane_pid, never pane_start_time. The ~16364-byte packed-argv limit (MAX_IMSGSIZE 16384 minus headers) is NOT documented in the man page: it is an imsg implementation detail, empirically measured on this machine's 3.6a, and must be treated as version-sensitive (the AC2 regression test pins behavior empirically against the real installed tmux rather than trusting a documented constant).
officialDocsConsulted.localConventionConflict: Issue AC5 offers 'pid ou pane_start_time' as the identity signal, but pane_start_time is absent on tmux 3.6a; stories pin pane_pid as the sole signal.

userStories.title: Deliver worker task prompts out-of-band via per-dispatch prompt file
userStories.description: As the cam supervisor, I need every worker task prompt (planner, auditor, implementer, reviewer, codex) written to a per-dispatch-uuid file under .claude/ and read at exec time, so that the tmux command length is O(1) in issue/PRD size and an oversized record can never exceed the packed-argv limit again (AC1, AC8, AC9, AC10).
acceptanceCriteria: A new module src/supervisor/task-prompt-file.ts exposes a writer that, given claudeDir + dispatch uuid + prompt text, writes .claude/.cam-task-prompt-<uuid>.txt and returns its path, AND reaps every stale sibling matching the .cam-task-prompt- stem BEFORE each write, so prompt files are unique per dispatch uuid, never leak between phases or cycles (AC9), and can never accumulate beyond one file (lifecycle floor for audit F-03). RED-ON-MAIN: this test file does not exist on main (verified 2026-07-27). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/task-prompt-file.test.ts]

The three ClaudeAdapter non-reviewer branches no longer embed the prompt inline in the rendered command. RED-ON-MAIN: the inline pattern is present at backend-adapter.ts:246/263/279 today (verified 2026-07-27). [oracle: ! grep -q 'shellEscape(required.taskPrompt)' src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts]

The reviewer branch (backend-adapter.ts:294) and CodexAdapter.renderActor (backend-adapter.ts:583-592, escapedPrompt at :592) also read the prompt from the file at exec time; adapter tests assert behaviorally that for a runtime-generated prompt of at least 40000 chars the rendered command does NOT contain the prompt body and its length is independent of prompt size (the O(1) claim of AC1). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/backend-adapter.test.ts test/supervisor/codex-adapter.test.ts]

AC8 injection safety: a fixture prompt containing all four of double-quote, dollar sign, backtick and newline arrives byte-intact to a REAL subprocess spawned with the rendered command shape (ADR-0039: real I/O at the wire boundary, no fake shell); the trailing-newline policy of the exec-time read is asserted INSIDE the test, never as a shell numeric compare in an oracle. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/task-prompt-file.test.ts]

The prompt-file path pattern .claude/.cam-task-prompt-*.txt is gitignored in BOTH .gitignore and templates/.gitignore, following the .cam-orchestrator-prompt.txt precedent (.gitignore:45, templates/.gitignore:22), so the first post-fix dispatch cannot leave an untracked file that trips the plan-preflight clean-tree refusal (plan-preflight.ts:118-122, ADR-0014; audit F-01). RED-ON-MAIN: '.cam-task-prompt-' matches neither file today (verified 2026-07-27). [oracle: grep -qF '.cam-task-prompt-' .gitignore && grep -qF '.cam-task-prompt-' templates/.gitignore]
The templates/ edit is followed by bun run embed-vendor in the same commit and the drift gate is green. [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]

AC10 invariance pin (green by construction, labelled as such): no -p / --output-format token is introduced into any rendered worker command (CAM-42 subscription rule, plan-argv.ts:15-17). [oracle: ! grep -q -- '--output-format' src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts]

AC14 sweep (audit F-05): every NEW detection assertion this story adds is proven red against unmodified main and the measured main-side result is recorded as a patterns.md bullet tagged 'CAM-433 red-on-main sweep (US-001)' in the same commit (durable non-rotating file, never handoff.json per patterns.md:907); the reviewer judges the sweep's veracity, this oracle only pins its existence. [oracle: grep -qF 'CAM-433 red-on-main sweep (US-001)' scripts/cam/patterns.md]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]

Full quality spine passes, including the file-size gate; any file pushed past its ceiling gets its scripts/file-size-budget.json raise in the SAME commit, derived from the real line count, never guessed (AC11). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Corrected pointers (audit F-07): the prompt is escaped inline at FIVE sites, backend-adapter.ts:246 (implementer), :263 (planner), :279 (auditor), :294 (reviewer) in ClaudeAdapter's switch, plus CodexAdapter.renderActor :583-592 (escapedPrompt at :592); backend-adapter.ts:311 is only a section comment, not a site. shellEscape itself is defined at :226 and stays for model names. Existing in-repo precedent for a file consumed at exec: writeCodexInstructionsFile (backend-adapter.ts:395), wired via '-c model_instructions_file=<path>'. The exec-time read must keep the argv O(1) AND injection-safe; note that command-substitution-style reads strip trailing newlines, which is why AC2 (US-004) requires the no-final-newline measurement inside the test. Adapters receive claudeDir/uuid already (opts.uuid); thread the prompt-file path through buildSpawnArgv opts rather than writing files inside the adapter render if that keeps seams testable, implementer's call, but the reap-before-write MUST live in the module so the bound holds for every caller. Gotcha (issue): use single quotes in any grep oracle touching $/backtick sequences; never combine grep -q with -l/-L. patterns.md grep keywords: 'oracle-falsifiability', 'derive-don't-freeze', 'shellEscape'. Budgets today: src/tmux/session.ts 589; backend-adapter has its own entry, derive the raise from wc -l if exceeded.

userStories.title: Add durable dispatch-failed marker with status projection and resolved stop semantics
userStories.description: As the orchestrator, I need a durable .claude/.cam-dispatch-failed.json marker (write/read/remove module) surfaced by cam status, so that any dispatch failure is observable without pane archaeology (AC4 primitive, AC12, AC13 read-surface).
acceptanceCriteria: A new module src/supervisor/dispatch-failed-marker.ts (mirroring src/supervisor/plan-escalation.ts) exposes write/read/remove for .claude/.cam-dispatch-failed.json carrying at least {phase, paneId, uuid, exitCode, stderr, reason, timestamp}; the filename is an exported named constant; remove is best-effort and never throws on an absent file (sidecar.ts:2534 removePlanPreflightFailedMarker precedent). RED-ON-MAIN: this test file does not exist on main (verified 2026-07-27). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/dispatch-failed-marker.test.ts]

The constant is used everywhere (audit F-06 split, clause 1): the bare filename literal appears in no src TypeScript file other than the defining module (plain-negation absence idiom, never -q with -l/-L). Invariance pin, green by construction on main (verified 2026-07-27: zero occurrences in src today); falsifiability is exercised by the sweep criterion via mutation. [oracle: ! grep -rq --include='*.ts' --exclude='dispatch-failed-marker.ts' -F '.cam-dispatch-failed' src]

DECISION resolved in this PRD (audit F-06 split, clause 2): performStop does NOT remove the dispatch-failed marker. Rationale: stopping the sidecar must not erase evidence of a failed dispatch, and the sibling precedent agrees, src/commands/stop.ts removes no cycle-state marker today (verified 2026-07-27); removal is wired exclusively to a subsequent successful dispatch/terminal (US-004/US-005). A test drives performStop with the marker present and asserts the file survives. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/dispatch-failed-marker.test.ts]

cam status projects the marker through the projectCycleState pattern (src/commands/status.ts:653 area, sibling of readPlanEscalatedMarker / readShipStalledMarker), with the projection asserted behaviorally in the new marker test file. AC12: .claude/.cam-dispatch-failed.json is registered in BOTH .gitignore and templates/.gitignore (sibling precedent: .cam-plan-escalated.json at .gitignore:89 and templates/.gitignore:17), and the templates/ edit is followed by bun run embed-vendor. userStories.title: Capture spawn stderr in the production loopSpawnFn and build the verified-dispatch helper
userStories.description: As the supervisor, I need the production Bun.spawnSync wrapper to surface stderr and a shared verified-dispatch helper that checks exit code, captured stderr and pane_pid identity on every tmux spawn, so that a failed or lying respawn becomes an observable terminal instead of silence (AC3, AC4, AC5 primitive).
acceptanceCriteria: Audit F-02 fix: the PRODUCTION loopSpawnFn is extracted from src/commands/sidecar.ts (~:2835-2842, where stderr is piped but discarded today) into an exported factory, and a behavioral test invokes that production factory against a REAL subprocess that writes known text to stderr and exits non-zero, asserting the decoded stderr text AND the non-zero exitCode (ADR-0039 real I/O at the wire boundary; an implementation returning stderr:'' unconditionally cannot pass this test). RED-ON-MAIN: this test file does not exist on main (verified 2026-07-27). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/sidecar-loop-spawn.test.ts]

Invariance pin, explicitly labelled as such (audit F-02): after widening the LoopSpawnFn/SpawnFn result type to carry stderr, every existing consumer (loop.ts, review.ts, plan-runner.ts, sidecar.ts) still compiles; this criterion pins the compile surface only and intentionally proves nothing about runtime stderr, which criterion 1 owns. [oracle: bun run typecheck]

A new shared verified-dispatch helper module runs a tmux spawn (set-option / respawn-pane / pipe-pane), inspects exit code and captured stderr, and on non-zero exit produces the full AC4 observable terminal: a structured event line (events.jsonl shape via the injected logEvent), a dispatch-failed marker write (US-002 module), and a notifyFn call; the tests assert all three fire and that silence is impossible. RED-ON-MAIN: this test file does not exist on main (verified 2026-07-27). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/verified-dispatch.test.ts]

AC5 identity verification lives in the helper: it captures pane identity BEFORE the respawn and re-reads it AFTER via tmux display-message '#{pane_pid}'; a zero-exit respawn whose pane_pid did NOT change is treated as a dispatch failure with the same AC4 terminal (this is the exact CAM-433 signature: respawn returns zero, the planner process never leaves the pane). pane_start_time MUST NOT be used as the signal: it is not a format variable on tmux 3.6a (expands to empty string, verified live and against man tmux, 2026-07-27); pane_pid is the identity signal. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/verified-dispatch.test.ts]

AC14 sweep (audit F-05): this story's new detection assertions are proven red against unmodified main and recorded as a patterns.md bullet tagged 'CAM-433 red-on-main sweep (US-003)' in the same commit. [oracle: grep -qF 'CAM-433 red-on-main sweep (US-003)' scripts/cam/patterns.md]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Full quality spine passes; src/commands/sidecar.ts (budget 3686) gets a real-count-derived raise in the same commit if pushed past its ceiling (AC11). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Bun docs (consulted): SyncSubprocess.stderr is a Buffer when piped; the current wrapper already passes stderr: stdio and decodes only stdout, so the fix decodes result.stderr symmetrically. The helper's unit tests may use behavioral DI-fakes for tmux (ADR-0039 allows fakes with behavior, not mock-called assertions); the REAL-tmux end-to-end proof lands in US-004's integration tests. Identity check gotcha: the relabel via set-option runs BEFORE respawn-pane in every current path (plan-runner.ts:793-794), so a label must never be read as respawn success; capture pane_pid before relabel+respawn, compare after. Wire the helper's deps (spawnFn with stderr, logEvent, marker writer, notifyFn) by injection so US-004/US-005 thread their existing seams. patterns.md grep keywords: 'sentinel', 'supervisor', 'spawn'.
